toast.markdown:
### A new version of Television (1.3.2) is available.

TV now has themes and dark mode! We’ve included a bunch of beautiful themes out of the box, with more to follow. You can also make your own themes just by asking your agent. Themes can do almost anything: not just colors and fonts but backgrounds, overlays, even animations. Read more in the #announcements channel of our Discord ([join now](https://discord.gg/8MfpZ48jD8) if you haven’t already.)
